capability: Find two cases your score cannot split
title: Lay the cards side by side.

hook.picture: Close: two pods each hand the whale an answer card; one score chip above them reads ✓ for both.

problem_in_viewer_words.body: The score said both bots were fine. One was not.

why_it_keeps_happening.picture: Pull back: the score squeezes two different answers into one reading. Three-times device: a good card and a bad card pass under the chip three times, every 2 beats, then 1, then half; ✓ and ✓ each time.
why_it_keeps_happening.words: Two different answers, one same score.

stakes.body: Any choice built on that score cannot tell the good assistant from the bad one.

solution_hint: Find two cases your score cannot split.

metaphor.body: Two answer cards laid side by side under one chip. If the chip reads them the same but they are not the same, that pair shows exactly what the score cannot see.

steps.picture: The whale lays the two answer cards side by side on the line under the one score chip.
steps.words: Find two cases your score cannot split.

steps.picture: A ring passes over both: the chip shows the same ✓ for each, though one card has a gap in its lines.
The whale adds a second chip that reads the gap; now the two cards get different marks, ✓ and ✕.
steps.words: Add the check that sees the gap.

steps.picture: The pair is boxed together and labelled.
steps.words: The pair that shows it: a witness.

real_case.claim: The tell-apart skill's contract was "calibrated by a 100-case evaluation (20 independent Sonnet testers, 5 adversarial judges)". The two-shop checkout example is fictional, marked CALIBRATION ONLY.

honest_limit.picture: A third pair, never laid out, slips by under the one chip, its gap unseen.
honest_limit.words: Pairs you never test stay hidden.

not_this.body: More numbers are not the fix.

ending_pattern.body: FELT framing returns. The two pods hand over their cards; now two chips read ✓ and ✕; the whale builds on the good card and its line holds.
ending_pattern.callback: The line that snapped in bar 2 is built again, in the same framing, on the right card and holds.

end_belief.body: Test your score on two different cases.
